comparison.objective: Erect four hinged crate walls and engage all corner catches; candidate locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Swing large panels, brace the crate, and push hooks through spring catches versus concentric fine-tool rotation and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Four corners latched with walls upright and crate released versus locked angle retained through articulated test cycles.
comparison.reason: Spring-catch assembly does not exercise threaded adjustment preservation.
